prediction.predicted_reply: We understand how frustrating it is to have your audio settings and default devices reset after a Windows update. Based on our historical cases, updates can sometimes impact audio configurations. If standard troubleshooting steps do not resolve the issue, we recommend contacting Microsoft support directly for further assistance.
